status: Read-only audit; no code/config change or GPU work

implementation.actor_value_gradient: Default1; tail differentiated through WM, terminal critic features and soft survival. scale_value_gradient retains reporting value at all weights, so tail magnitude alone is not gradient attribution. Weight0 disables all tail graph gradients, including survival tail gradients.
implementation.bound: Upper only minimum(value,max_step_reward*discounted_remaining_steps); no lower bound or uncertainty calibration. Critic targets bounded, critic predictions fitted without clipping. Cap saturation kills critic-value derivative but surviving soft-survival derivative remains.

cap.note: Configured aim4 contributes .08 to bound although level0 aim_weight0; conservative but loose by8 in long-horizon value.

implementation.clip: Distributed gradients averaged then global L2 norm clipped1 then elementwise .1; actor_grad logged is PRE-clip norm. Clipping does not constrain Adam parameter displacement or policy action change. Full scope exposes all encoder/decoder weights.
implementation.chest: upright bounded[0,1]*2*.02 <=.04 per step, comparable to root2 and twice pelvis-upright1; excess -2*.02*sum(normalized squared violations), unbounded below. Chest terms retain level0 weight.
implementation.validation: WM validation each100 iterations; cached model_ready permits updates until next validation. Low averaged WM loss does not establish policy-relevant Jacobian correctness.

interpretation: Concurrent physical degradation, growing tail and critic error suggest model/critic/actor distribution shift; cannot identify a single cause. Previous body-output actorvalue0 degradation rules out bootstrap-only explanation.

Compare finite differences to autograd and real physical short-rollout action perturbations.
